hooks.command: git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^??' | python -c "import sys,json; f=[l[3:].rstrip() for l in sys.stdin if l.strip()]; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'⚠ Uncommitted changes from prior session: ' + ' '.join(f[:10]) + (f' (+{len(f)-10} more)' if len(f)>10 else '')})) if f else None"
